Geopolitics.title: U.S. and Iran resume attacks. And, Fauci to face Senate questions on COVID pandemic
Geopolitics.summary: The U.S. and Iran have resumed fighting after Iran attacked U.S. forces in the Middle East yesterday. And, a Senate committee will question Anthony Fauci about the COVID-19 pandemic.

Geopolitics.title: Death toll rises to 18 as rescuers comb through quake rubble in southwestern Japan
Geopolitics.summary: Soldiers and emergency workers combed through a badly damaged shopping mall and collapsed houses looking for trapped survivors Wednesday after a powerful earthquake that killed at least 18 people, including a foreigner, in southwestern Japan.

Geopolitics.title: Watch: Japanese mall explodes after magnitude 6.8 earthquake
Geopolitics.summary: Search teams are still looking for survivors in the collapsed Aeon shopping centre.
